content.json:
## Agent gateway
Token use, limits and agent activity. Per-user rows come from runtime traces (users are Entra object ids); team, agent and model totals come from APIM token metrics. See also **Agent gateway: run explorer** and **Agent gateway: tools**.

Costs are estimates: tokens times the prices below (USD per 1M tokens; defaults are gpt-5-mini list prices, check your Azure price sheet).

parameters.name: PriceInput
parameters.label: Input $/1M
parameters.description: USD per 1M tokens: check your Azure price sheet

parameters.name: PriceCached
parameters.label: Cached input $/1M
parameters.description: USD per 1M tokens: check your Azure price sheet

parameters.name: PriceOutput
parameters.label: Output $/1M
parameters.description: USD per 1M tokens: check your Azure price sheet

content.query:
let names = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d) and Name startswith "invoke_agent " and isnotempty(tostring(Properties["agw.user.name"]))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, name = tostring(Properties["agw.user.name"]), upn = tostring(Properties["agw.user.upn"]))
    by user = tostring(Properties["agw.user.id"])
| project user, name, upn;
let p_in = todouble("{PriceInput}"); let p_cached = todouble("{PriceCached}"); let p_out = todouble("{PriceOutput}");
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name startswith "invoke_agent "
| extend user = tostring(Properties["agw.user.id"]), team = tostring(Properties["agw.team"]),
         cost_center = tostring(Properties["agw.cost_center"]),
         input = toint(Properties["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), output = toint(Properties["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]),
         cached = coalesce(toint(Properties["agw.usage.cached_tokens"]), 0)
| summarize runs = count(), input = sum(input), cached = sum(cached), output = sum(output),
            team = take_any(team), cost_center = take_any(cost_center) by user
| join kind=leftouter names on user
| extend who = iff(isempty(name), user, strcat(name, " (", upn, ")")),
         cost_usd = round(((input - cached) * p_in + cached * p_cached + output * p_out) / 1e6, 4)
| project who, cost_usd
| order by cost_usd desc
| take 25
content.title: Estimated cost per user (USD)

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens") | summarize tokens = sum(Sum) by team = tostring(Properties["Team"]), bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Tokens by team

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens") | summarize tokens = sum(Sum) by agent = tostring(Properties["Agent"]), model = tostring(Properties["Deployment"]) | order by tokens desc
content.title: Tokens by agent and model

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens") | summarize tokens = sum(Sum) by cost_center = tostring(Properties["CostCenter"]), team = tostring(Properties["Team"]) | order by tokens desc
content.title: Tokens by cost center (chargeback)

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name has "Tokens" | summarize tokens = sum(Sum) by Name | where tokens > 0 | order by tokens desc
content.title: Token types (cached and reasoning tokens affect cost)

content.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ResponseCode in (401, 403, 429) | summarize requests = count() by api = ApiId, status = ResponseCode, reason = LastErrorReason, policy = LastErrorSource | order by requests desc
content.title: Refused requests: which policy and why

content.query:
let names = AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d) and Name startswith "invoke_agent " and isnotempty(tostring(Properties["agw.user.name"]))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, name = tostring(Properties["agw.user.name"]), upn = tostring(Properties["agw.user.upn"]))
    by user = tostring(Properties["agw.user.id"])
| project user, name, upn;
AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name startswith "invoke_agent " | extend user = tostring(Properties["agw.user.id"]), team = tostring(Properties["agw.team"]), cost_center = tostring(Properties["agw.cost_center"]), tier = tostring(Properties["agw.tier"]), agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]), stop = tostring(Properties["agw.stop_reason"]), tokens = toint(Properties["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]) + toint(Properties["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]) | summarize runs = count(), tokens = sum(tokens), blocked = countif(Success == false), budget_stops = countif(stop == "budget_exhausted") by user, team, cost_center, tier, agent | join kind=leftouter names on user | extend who = iff(isempty(name), user, strcat(name, " (", upn, ")")) | project who, team, cost_center, tier, agent, runs, tokens, blocked, budget_stops, user | order by tokens desc
content.title: Users: runs, tokens and blocks

content.query: AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name startswith "chat " and Success == false | summarize hits = count() by limit = tostring(Properties["agw.limit"]), bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Limits hit over time

content.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ApiId == "agw-models" and isnotempty(BackendResponseCode) | summarize calls = count(), throttled = countif(BackendResponseCode == 429), p95_ms = percentile(BackendTime, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Model calls, throttling and p95 latency
